parse.title: Game controls
parse.wikitext:
==Keyboard==
The keyboard is used to chat with other players using the [[Chat Interface]]. Players can chat in [[Chat_Interface#Public|Public]], [[Chat_Interface#Private|Private]], [[Chat_Interface#Channel|Channel]], [[Chat_Interface#Clan|Clan]], and [[Chat_Interface#Trade|Trade]].

===Control keys===
The Control keys are used to run, if run energy is toggled to walk, and vice versa. Running may also be toggled in the [[Settings]] side-panel or by clicking the [[Minimap#Energy orb|run energy data orb]], but all movement will be made at a run until walking is selected again, or the player's run energy falls to zero.

===Shift keys===
The Shift keys can be used to quickly drop items in the inventory of the player, if shift click to drop is enabled in the [[Settings]] panel. The Shift keys can also be used to move items in the inventory, if Shift Anti Drag is enabled in the [[Settings]] panel ([[Official Client]] only).

===Alt keys===
The Alt keys are used to move the main view, if the primary mouse button is held down.

===Tab key===
The Tab key is used to message the last player.

===Arrow keys===
The arrow keys are used to pan the main view and minimap, rotating or raising and lowering the viewpoint, though if close to a hill, it may not be possible to lower the viewpoint.

While it can be useful to see items on the main view by rotating the map, holding the map centred north while trying to navigate is recommended, as it is easy to forget the map angle and set off in completely the wrong direction.

===Number keys===
The number keys are used to enter amounts. Using the 5, 10 or all options for other items is quicker, even if players have less, or don't have room to carry all. Players can also press a number key to select from a list of responses or options, with the place of the response on the list from top to bottom being the number to press. Number keys are also used to quickly select one of the options in a [[Portal Nexus]] and [[Ornate jewellery box]].

===Character keys===
The character keys are used to quickly select one of the options in a [[Portal Nexus]] and [[Ornate jewellery box]].

===F-Keys===
The Escape key and F-keys can be used to quickly select one of the side-panels of the control panel. This can be configured within the controls section of the [[Settings]] panel.

===Spacebar===
The spacebar can be used to select the "Click here to continue" option when talking to an [[NPC]].
